stem: A technician is asked to compare PPFD before and after an authorized fixture-height change. What makes the comparison strongest?
choices: Repeat the same canopy grid with consistent measurement height and sensor orientation
Use only the brightest new point
Measure from different heights to get more variety
Compare dimmer percentages instead of canopy measurements
rationale: Repeat the same canopy grid with consistent measurement height and sensor orientation. This preserves the measurement, data-quality, record or role-boundary principle being assessed.
